decisions.executionNote: Raise and orient the left gripper toward the mallet handle, with small continuous elbow-up approach increments. Right arm stays parked.
Continue down-facing approach above the near end of the mallet shaft. Match its nearly forward direction and inspect alignment before closing.
Advance along the shaft and lower to grasp height, using wrist alignment; handle is still ahead of the open fingertips.
Center the shaft between the left fingers, align to its slight angle, and close. Retention will be checked during the subsequent lift.
Keep the left gripper closed and lift vertically to verify that the mallet rises with it before approaching the keys.
Mallet is visibly retained. Raise and yaw it toward the keys, keeping the left wrist in its own workspace; approach the leftmost red key from above.
Align the mallet head over the first red key and begin a controlled vertical descent. Slight yaw gives reach across the keyboard without crossing the left wrist into the right workspace.
Center on the red key, tap vertically, then lift the mallet 5 cm before moving to the next key. Contact height is estimated from the visible mallet and key surfaces.
Move one key to the right while raised, then tap the orange second key. Keep the mallet securely closed and inspect the contact alignment.
Lift 6 cm clear of the orange key, then move above the third yellow key, preserving the left-to-right order.
Tap the yellow third key at the established contact height, then rebound vertically by 3.6 cm before any further sideways motion.
Increase the post-hit clearance to allow for slight mallet tilt, then position over the fourth green key without touching intervening keys.
Strike the fourth green key vertically, then rebound. A further clearance lift will precede the next lateral move to ensure the mallet tip clears by over 2.5 cm.
Finish the clearance lift after green, then position the retained mallet over the fifth light-blue key while keeping the left wrist left of center.
Tap the fifth light-blue key, then rebound vertically while maintaining the mallet grasp and arm configuration.
Finish lifting the mallet clear of the fifth key, then move right above the sixth dark-blue key.
Strike the sixth dark-blue key at the established height and lift vertically, keeping the left wrist on its own side and the mallet grasp closed.
Complete the clearance lift after the sixth key, then align over the seventh purple key. Keep the mallet closed and both arms separated.
Tap the seventh purple key, then rebound vertically. Maintain the mallet grip and leave additional lift before the final sideways move.
Finish lifting clear of purple, then align above the eighth and rightmost magenta key. Keep the left wrist left of center and the right arm parked.
Strike the final rightmost magenta key and rebound vertically. Keep holding the mallet, with additional clearance lift next if the episode remains active.
